name: pocket-i-lab
description: Keep a consented, redacted joinmultiplayer experiment journal from the Codex task you are already using.

interface.shortDescription: Let this Codex task keep a safe public lab journal.
interface.longDescription: Pocket I Lab connects the current Codex task to a public joinmultiplayer.ai experiment run. It publishes only user-visible prompts and answers plus allowlisted tool status after local redaction; it never publishes hidden reasoning, tool output, file contents, environment data, local paths, or credentials.
